raw_text: The True Confidence strike is a major escalation. Three dead — first fatalities from Houthi shipping attacks. The ASBM used appears to be a modified Toufan missile based on damage assessment photos. Indian crew members among the casualties, which could force India to take a harder line on Red Sea security. War risk premiums already spiking. This is going to have serious implications for India-bound shipping costs.
